page_note: 该页为EIA财务评论幻灯片，含一幅无编号的堆积柱状图（2015–2024年各年探明储量增加量，含负值与灰点总量标记）以及右侧灰底说明文字栏。

heading.title: Proved reserve additions for select energy companies

series_names: total crude oil and natural gas reserve additions

components.evidence: each year's bar is built of gold, brown and near-black segments labelled extensions/improved recovery/revisions
2015, 2016, 2019 and 2020 dark segments run below the baseline; ticks read -5, -10, -15, -20
grey round markers sit over each year's bar for "total crude oil and natural gas reserve additions"
a heavy black horizontal rule is drawn at 0 across the whole plot width
thin horizontal rules at every 5-unit tick, no vertical rules in the plot
"billion barrels of oil equivalent" under the bold heading; value axis shows bare 35, 30 ... -20
colour-matched texts "extensions and discoveries", "improved recovery", "revisions" set beside the bars, no swatch legend
"Data source: Evaluate Energy" and "Note: Select energy companies includes 158 global oil and natural gas companies."
grey-tinted column right of the plot: "Organic proved reserve additions create new proved reserves from improved recovery..."
the four series names form a column at the right edge of the plot band, level with the bars
"improved recovery" band is a few pixels tall in 2022-2024, its name pushed outside to the right

new_components.name: stack_spans_zero_with_total_marker
new_components.evidence: revisions segments go below 0 while other segments go above; grey dot marks the net total instead of bar length
new_components.why_it_matters: 柱长不再等于总量，读取任一分段都要分别定位零线上下的端点，总量只能由灰点读出。

new_components.name: headline_states_data_value
new_components.evidence: slide title: "...totaled 18 billion barrels in 2024" restates the 2024 total marker value
new_components.why_it_matters: 18这个数只写在页标题里而非图上，取值须把标题文字与2024年灰点对应起来。

new_components.name: series_label_leader_to_marker
new_components.evidence: short horizontal rules run from "total crude oil and natural gas reserve additions" text toward the 2024 grey dots
new_components.why_it_matters: 该系列名靠引出线而非色块与标记关联，解析时容易把它当作独立文字块而丢失系列身份。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数字标注，网格线间隔为5个单位（约38像素），要在5%误差内读数，1.5这类小分段容许误差只有±0.08（约0.6像素），2022–2024年的"improved recovery"带只有几像素高，根本无法分辨；另外堆积段必须由累积端点相减才能得到（如2016年12.5=柱顶12.9减去下方约0.4），而柱长又被零线上下的正负段拆开，总量只能由灰点单独读取。相比之下年份与系列名齐备（步骤3尚可），标题也是加粗文本（步骤4较轻）。
